props.lead: Allergy safety on delivery apps is thin: in one audit, 80% of 50 listed restaurants offered no allergy features at all[^a3c11].

props.title: Most listings carry no allergy intake

props.text: SafePlate checked 50 restaurants on DoorDash and Uber Eats and found 80% had zero allergy safety features[^a3c11].

props.label: listings with no allergy features
props.caption: The allergy field users trust often never reaches the kitchen[^a3c11].

props.text: As of October 2024, 9% of US online grocery shoppers had Instacart+, against 25% for Walmart+[^a2c15].

props.measure: Share of US online grocery shoppers
props.caption: Walmart+ reaches nearly three times as many shoppers as Instacart+[^a2c15].
